name: Jousting
body:
Feat Selection

The jousting dragoon style’s feat selection are as follows: mounted combat, ride-by attack, trick riding, spirited charge, mounted skirmisher, and power attack.

Dragoon Style

At 2nd level, the dragoon increases the reach of weapons they attack with when charging by 5 feet.

Improved Dragoon Style

At 6th level, the dragoon can make a full attack at the end of a mounted charge if their mount moves at least 10 feet, and they receive a bonus to any Ride checks made during this charge equal to 1/2 their dragoon level (minimum of +1).

Greater Dragoon Style

At 11th level, the dragoon rolls twice for damage and takes the better result if they make a mounted charge while wielding a reach weapon. In addition, their mount gains a +10 foot enhancement bonus to their movement speed when charging.

Master Dragoon Style

At 17th level, the dragoon ignores all DR including DR/- when making a mounted charge, and the attack deals double damage (this stacks with Spirited Charge).
